auditor_result.root_cause: Lambda function OOM due to unbounded in-memory cache growth

patcher_result.remediation_strategy: Increase Lambda memory and force rolling restart

commands.description: Force new ECS service deployment to replace running tasks
commands.command: aws ecs update-service --cluster omnitrace-cluster --service omnitrace-api-gateway --force-new-deployment --region us-east-1
commands.rollback_command: aws ecs update-service --cluster omnitrace-cluster --service omnitrace-api-gateway --desired-count 2 --region us-east-1

patcher_result.expected_outcome: Lambda memory pressure relieved; service stabilizes within 2 minutes
reasoning_chain: Memory increase addresses OOM root cause
Force deployment replaces in-flight requests with fresh instances
